claims.text: Your training and health data lives in IndexedDB on your device. It leaves only to destinations you set up: the AI provider whose key you enter (Anthropic, OpenAI or Google), the platforms you connect through their extensions, intervals.icu to check the API key you add for it, and your own Google Drive if you turn on sync. Separately, every page loads Umami analytics, which records anonymous page views and product events, never your workouts, health data or keys. Kaiord's own servers only serve this site and convert workouts in transit; they store nothing.
